summary: iter242 — frontend-only test of Maker Studio Elements Editor. Verified editor mounts only after a design exists, add-shape/add-text increment opCount, 4-element cap is enforced, edit panel exposes the correct controls for shape vs text, primitive change mutates the design state, delete removes the element with toast, Border section gates thickness slider on style!=none, and Holes section gates diameter+placement on count>0.
critical_code_review_comments: MakerStudio.jsx is now ~1186 lines — beyond the 700-line file-size guideline. Recommend extracting ElementsEditor + SelectRow + SliderRow + ParametricControls + CamStrategyCard + TemplateGallery into their own files under /app/frontend/src/components/studio/. This would also let you unit-test each editor sub-piece.

ElementsEditor.addShape always inserts primitive='star'; consider letting the user pick from SHAPE_OPTIONS at insertion time, or default to the first whitelisted primitive (matches the backend _sanitize_design enum order).

Toast 'Max 4 elements per design' fires correctly when functional cap is hit but the sonner toast was hard to reliably catch via Playwright text=… selectors. Recommend adding data-testid='studio-elements-cap-toast' on the toast.error call (toast.error supports an `id` and arbitrary props) so future regression tests can pin it deterministically.

/studio/render is called from the design-update useEffect with auth headers but anonymous users get 401 — expected, but the editor swallows the error silently. Consider showing a one-time inline hint ('Sign in to see live preview while editing') instead of a silent failure so anonymous makers know why the canvas isn't refreshing.

design.border_thickness is only present after the Thickness slider has been touched at least once; the slider falls back to 0.2 via value={design.border_thickness ?? 0.2}, but the backend _sanitize_design should be checked to ensure it accepts an absent border_thickness and applies the same 0.2 default — otherwise render output drifts vs. preview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproducer: visit /studio anonymously → click [data-testid=studio-template-patriotic-veteran] (note: first template 'lake-house' has the SAME prompt string as EXAMPLE_PROMPTS[0], so click-handler success can be hard to detect via prompt change — use a different template for click verification). Editor mounts at [data-testid=studio-elements-editor]. /api/studio/render returns 401 for anonymous (by design) — preview won't refresh but design state mutates correctly. All Elements Editor selectors render as documented in the review request. Backend not retested this round per agent_to_agent_context_note.
